title: Heterogeneity-Adaptive Diffusion Schrodinger Bridge for PET-Guided Whole-Body MRI Translation
tldr_zh: I2SB 配对桥做全身 LAVA→T2，VLM 区域嵌入 + PET 空间噪声调制/注意力；作者报告 SSIM 91.1% 超 ResViT 4.5 pp，病灶切片 PET 引导 +0.8 dB
tldr_en: I2SB bridge for whole-body LAVA-to-T2 MRI with VLM-derived region embeddings and PET-guided spatial noise modulation/attention; authors report SSIM 91.1% (+4.5 pp over ResViT), +0.8 dB on lesion slices.
key_numbers: Avg SSIM 91.1% / PSNR 26.25 dB (HA-DSB PET) vs ResViT 86.6 / 23.95, I2SB 84.6 / 22.77, SelfRDB 84.9 / 22.06 (Table 1)
PET guidance on lesion slices: PSNR 23.46->24.26 (+0.80 dB), SSIM 86.4->88.1 (+1.7) vs +0.16 dB / +0.3 on full testset (Table 2)
Dataset: 246 subjects, train 204 (20,306 slices) / test 42 (4,162 slices); Table 1 on 2,087 slices from 21 subjects (Sec. 3)
Noise modulation range s_min=0.2, s_max=2.0; T=200, beta_max=0.35 (Sec. 3)
